 p=run(args);v={'baseline_index':i,'command':args,'exit':p.returncode,'stderr':p.stderr.decode('utf8','replace'),'raw_stdout_bytes':len(p.stdout),'raw_stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest()}
 if p.returncode==0:
  parts=p.stdout.split(b'\0');assert parts[-1]==b'';parts.pop();assert len(parts)%2==0
  rows=[]

   meta=parts[k].decode().split();assert len(meta)==5
   oldmode,newmode,oldblob,newblob,status=meta;assert oldmode.startswith(':')
   rows.append({'path':parts[k+1].decode('utf8'),'status':status,'old_mode':oldmode[1:],'new_mode':newmode,'old_blob':oldblob,'new_blob':newblob})

  v['event_metadata']=compact;v['event_metadata_sha256']=sha(compact)
